newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Hartford, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hartford, Conn..

text.p: SEALED BIDS will be received by the CITY OF HARTFORD, CONNECTICUT until 11:30 (E.S.T.) THURSDAY

at the City Treasurer's Office located at 10 Prospect Street, Hartford, Connecticut, 06106 for the purchase, when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest to date of delivery, of the whole of:
The Bonds are payable annually on December 15 in the principal amounts and years as set forth below.

The bonds will be dated December 15, 1996 with interest payable on June 15, 1997 and therefrom semiannually on the fifteenth day of December and June in each year at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful bidder. The Bonds are subject to redemption prior to maturity at the option of the City in the years and prices as follows:

The bonds will be issued only as fully registered bonds without coupons and, when issued, will be registered in the name of Cede & Co., as bondholder and nominee for The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (

Purchases of beneficial interests in the bonds may be made in book-entry form only, in the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The bonds will be certified by Bank of Boston Connecticut. The legality of the issue will be passed upon by Updike, Kelly & Spellacy, P.C., of Hartford, Connecticut, bond counsel to the City. The bonds are not qualified to be and will not be designated (qualified tax-exempt obligations'' by the City in accordance with Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. Notices of Sale, bid forms and copies of the Official Statement may be obtained from Ms. M. Terri Larson, Vice President, Bank of Boston Connecticut, 100 Pearl Street, Hartford, Connecticut 06103 (Tel. No. (203) 727-6554). The right is reserved to reject any and all bids and to waive any irregularity or informality with respect to any bid.
